about: Adaptive multi-session race building a team task board web app. After every fresh session the app is started and tested automatically (HTTP API + headless Chrome DOM/screenshot); the next prompt is a bug report from failed checks (same fixed rule as the Roblox race) or the next roadmap feature. Fully automated: no human or Studio in the loop.
agents_md:
# Team Task Board

Web app: Node.js (no npm dependencies), `node server.js`, static frontend in `public/`.

Keep this file up to date: after every change, record the design decisions (API shapes, field names, colors, rules) and where things live, so the next session can continue without re-reading everything.

roadmap.prompt: Let's build a team task board web app in this folder. Use Node.js with NO npm dependencies (only built-in modules): `node server.js` starts it on the port in the PORT environment variable (default 3000), serves the frontend from `public/`, and stores data in `data/board.json`. Today: a board with three columns - To Do, In Progress, Done - and a form to add a card with a title. API: GET /api/cards returns an array of cards, POST /api/cards with JSON {title, column} creates one and returns it with an id. New cards default to To Do.
Next: let me move cards between columns by drag and drop, and delete cards. API: PATCH /api/cards/:id with JSON {column} moves a card, DELETE /api/cards/:id removes it.

Add labels. A card can have one label: Bug (red #e5484d), Feature (blue #3e63dd) or Chore (gray #8b8d98), stored in the card's `label` field. Show the label as a colored pill on the card, and add a filter bar to show only cards with one label.
Add due dates in a `dueDate` field (YYYY-MM-DD). Overdue cards get a red border and cards due today get an amber border.
Make it look good: dark theme with background #0f1115, columns as rounded panels, violet accent #8b7cf6, and a card-count badge on each column header. It should work on a laptop screen and a phone.

Add assignees. Team members are Alice, Bob, Carol and Dan; a card has an `assignee` field. Show an avatar circle with the person's initials on the card, and add an assignee filter alongside the label filter we added.

Feedback from the team: In Progress should hold at most 3 cards. The API must reject a move or create that would exceed it with HTTP 409, and the UI should show a toast message. Keep the label colors we picked.
Add a search box that filters cards by title, and a "Clear filters" button that resets the search and also the label and assignee filters.

bug_text.server_starts: The app doesn't start (node server.js) or the page doesn't load
bug_text.columns_render: I don't see the three columns (To Do, In Progress, Done) on the page.
bug_text.cards_api: Creating a card with POST /api/cards doesn't work (or GET /api/cards doesn't return it).
bug_text.card_renders: Cards I create don't show up on the board.
bug_text.persistence: Cards disappear after restarting the server.
bug_text.move_api: Moving a card with PATCH /api/cards/:id {column} doesn't work.
bug_text.delete_api: Deleting a card with DELETE /api/cards/:id doesn't work.
bug_text.labels: Labels don't work: the label isn't saved on the card or the label pill / colors don't show.
bug_text.due_dates: Due dates don't work: dueDate isn't saved or overdue cards aren't highlighted.
bug_text.dark_theme: The dark theme isn't there (background #0f1115 with the violet #8b7cf6 accent).
bug_text.assignees: Assignees don't work: the assignee isn't saved or the initials avatar doesn't show.
bug_text.wip_limit: The In Progress limit isn't enforced: a 4th card in In Progress is accepted instead of getting HTTP 409.
bug_text.search: There's no working search box and Clear filters button.
